description:
## [1.30.0](https://github.com/dhrubonai/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.30.0) (2026-10-14)

### Bug Fixes

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** fixed streaming broken since Oct 14. MovieBox backend stopped returning signed DASH resources for some titles, causing playback to fail (black screen) while downloads and subtitles still worked. The patch now falls back to direct file URLs from the resource/v2 API when no signed DASH resource is available. Also improves download start reliability. Telegram popup and coffee button preserved.
